  \caption[Training losses on the input-level targets]{The five EfficientZero training losses on the three input-level targets, against training batches. Logarithmic ordinate on the three supervised losses, which stay positive; linear on the consistency loss, which is a negative cosine similarity, and on the total, which carries the consistency loss with a coefficient of two and therefore turns negative once the supervised terms fall below it. The targets ran for different numbers of iterations, so their curves end at different batch counts.}
